product_one_liner.value: Kojo helps trade and self-perform general contractors manage materials procurement and inventory, connecting field, office, warehouse, accounting, and distributor teams from takeoff to closeout.
product_one_liner.notes: The company announcement describes materials procurement and inventory management for trade and self-perform general contractors, connecting the named teams from takeoff to closeout: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20251016530530/en/Kojo-Poised-to-Revolutionize-Construction-Materials-Management.

pricing_page.notes: Kojo has a public pricing page describing unlimited users and data, no hidden fees, and custom quotes; published dollar prices are not required: https://www.usekojo.com/pricing.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: DP Electric and Gallo Mechanical both appear in the customer logo area on Kojo's pricing page: https://www.usekojo.com/pricing. | named_customers.0: DP Electric appears in the customer logo area of Kojo's pricing page. | named_customers.1: Gallo Mechanical appears in the customer logo area of Kojo's pricing page.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 163 employees, which falls within 101–200: https://linkedin.com/company/kojotechnologies. A profile-associated employee count is a proxy rather than an audited workforce total.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: Kojo's company profile explicitly identifies its headquarters as San Francisco, California: https://linkedin.com/company/kojotechnologies. | hq_country: Kojo's company profile identifies its primary location as San Francisco, California, United States: https://linkedin.com/company/kojotechnologies.

founded_year.notes: Kojo's company profile explicitly lists 2018 as its founding year: https://linkedin.com/company/kojotechnologies.

eng_blog.notes: The public blog index is oriented toward procurement, product updates, industry news, and company announcements: https://www.usekojo.com/blog. One qualifying engineering implementation post was located, about rebranding the React Native application: https://medium.com/kojo-engineering/rebranding-to-kojo-4ad8d8660e5d. The engineering publication index did not expose a second qualifying post, so the two-post threshold is not met by the available evidence.

public_docs.notes: Kojo's public developer documentation includes authentication, API limits, GraphQL and REST references, and additional documentation sections: https://docs.kojo.tech/docs/.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The readable current job board lists Demand Gen Lead and Revenue Operations Support Analyst. Neither title is a qualifying AI, ML, or data-science role: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/Kojo.

model_provider.value: OpenAI GPT-4 and Hugging Face transformer models
model_provider.notes: Kojo explicitly names OpenAI's GPT-4 and Hugging Face transformer models in its Intelligence Layer announcement: https://www.usekojo.com/blog/kojo-intelligence-layer.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Kojo states that it successfully completed a SOC 2 audit, rather than describing certification as in progress: https://www.usekojo.com/security. | compliance_certs.0: Kojo's security page explicitly confirms successful completion of a SOC 2 audit.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: Kojo's announcement explicitly calls the investment Series C extension funding, corroborated by the funding report: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20251016530530/en/Kojo-Poised-to-Revolutionize-Construction-Materials-Management and https://www.constructiondive.com/news/construction-tech-funding-Q4-2025/808986. | funding_date: The funding report dates the Series C extension announcement to October 16, 2025, giving 2025-10: https://www.constructiondive.com/news/construction-tech-funding-Q4-2025/808986. | funding_amount_usd: The latest identified funding report describes a $10 million Series C extension from Wesco: https://www.constructiondive.com/news/construction-tech-funding-Q4-2025/808986.

raised_18mo.notes: The October 16, 2025 Series C extension falls within the eighteen months before November 9, 2026: https://www.constructiondive.com/news/construction-tech-funding-Q4-2025/808986 and https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20251016530530/en/Kojo-Poised-to-Revolutionize-Construction-Materials-Management.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current job board lists only Demand Gen Lead and Revenue Operations Support Analyst, neither an SDR, BDR, or account executive: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/Kojo.

launched_6mo.notes: August 2026 releases introduced configurable invoice-matching tolerances and role-based tool-inventory permissions, within the six-month window: https://support.usekojo.com/hc/en-us/articles/54889286601491-Weekly-Release-Notes-August-17-23-2026 and https://support.usekojo.com/hc/en-us/articles/54206867976979-Weekly-Release-Notes-Aug-1-7-2026. These add functional controls rather than only UI fixes; whether they meet the subjective 'major' threshold is less certain.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Micah Rodman's profile dates his Co-Founder & CEO role to January 2026, within the twelve-month window: https://linkedin.com/in/micah-rodman-589776160. Maria Davidson also states that she moved from CEO to Executive Chair: https://maria-davidson.com/. This supports a CEO transition, not an external hire.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: Kojo's Revenue Operations Support Analyst posting explicitly says its Sales and Customer Success teams run on Salesforce: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/Kojo/96c079f3-712b-4782-a20f-4118d53988c7. | crm_stack_signal.0: The Revenue Operations Support Analyst posting explicitly identifies Salesforce as the system used by Kojo's Sales and Customer Success teams.
